role: Extension of RecoveryScoreCalculator holding the Tier-1 HRV sub-score (ln(RMSSD) z-score + RHR/DFA/CV/ANS/staleness adjustments, readiness and absolute-RMSSD fallbacks) and the sleep sub-score. The adjustment functions are the single source of each adjustment's arithmetic: ScoreDetailBuilder reads them to write the shown adjustments.

units.does: Tier-1 HRV score 0-100: with baseline stats and rmssd>0 returns clamp(baselineNormalisedScore); else readiness*10 clamped; else 50 (neutral) when rmssd<=0; else absolute RMSSD threshold score clamped.

branches.effect: true: returns min(100,max(0,baselineNormalisedScore(...))); false: falls through to fallbacks
true: returns readiness*10 clamped 0-100 (no baseline used even if rmssd is valid); false: continue
false: returns AbsoluteRMSSDFallback.neutralScore (50); true: returns clamped absoluteRMSSDScore(rmssd)

units.does: Primary Tier-1 path: zToRecoveryScore((ln rmssd - lnRmssdMean)/lnRmssdSD) plus rhrAdjustment, the points of dfaAlpha1Adjustment and cvAdjustment(lnRmssdCV7Day) (0 when they return nil), ansBalanceAdjustment, minus the penalty of baselineStalenessPenalty (0 when not stale); unclamped sum returned.

Resting-HR adjustment: zHR=(meanHR-meanHRBaseline)/meanHRSD times rhrZScoreMultiplier (-5), clamped to [rhrClampMin, rhrClampMax] = [-10,+10]; 0 when meanHR nil. Internal: the one copy of this arithmetic, read by calculateTier1's baselineNormalisedScore and by ScoreDetailBuilder.restingHRAdjustments for the shown adjustment.

Baseline-staleness penalty: nil when stats.lastDataPointDate is nil or the baseline is under BaselineStaleness.staleAfterDays old at referenceDate (baselineStalenessDays); otherwise (days, penalty) with penalty = min(maxPenalty, penaltyPerWeek × (1 + weeksStale)). The one copy, read by baselineNormalisedScore (deducts penalty) and ScoreDetailBuilder.baselineStalenessAdjustments (shows days and rounded penalty). Named with the Penalty suffix so check_science_register discovers it; claimed by composite-weights-60-25-15.

branches.effect: returns nil; else returns (daysSince, capped penalty)

units.does: Absolute RMSSD fallback score from RecoveryScoreConstants.AbsoluteRMSSDFallback thresholds 1-4 (descending), else scoreBelow.

Sleep sub-score: nil without sleepData; SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze(...).enhancedScore for every night with sleep minutes (staged or not; the analyzer gives unmeasured sections neutral credit); zeroMinuteNightScore for the zero-minute night analyze declines.

flags.text: docs/FLOWCHART.md describes the Tier-2 sleep sub-score as duration 35%/efficiency 25%/deep 25%/REM 15% (the weighted formula), but any night with sleep minutes is scored by SleepScienceAnalyzer.enhancedScore; the weighted formula (now zeroMinuteNightScore) only runs for zero-minute nights. The code's own doc comment now says so; the doc page still needs correcting.

units.does: Sleep sub-score for a night with no sleep minutes (the only night SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze declines): (min(totalSleepIncludingNapMinutes/60 / max(typicalSleepHours,1), 1.2)·Sleep.duration + measured efficiency/100 (neutral 0.5 when unmeasured)·Sleep.efficiency + 0.5·Sleep.deepSleep + 0.5·Sleep.remSleep)·100, clamped to ScoringBounds 0...100. A qualifying nap still credits duration; deep and REM take the neutral half credit since a zero-minute night has no stage share. Same arithmetic as the former basicSleepScore, whose stage branch could never run here.

DFA α1 adjustment as (kind, points): (.alphaBalanced, dfaOptimalBonus +5) for 0.75<=α1<=1.0, (.alphaStrained, dfaFatiguePenalty -5) for α1>1.2, (.alphaReduced, dfaIrregularPenalty -3) for α1<0.60; nil for nil α1 or the neutral margins 0.60-0.75 and 1.0-1.2. The one copy: baselineNormalisedScore adds the points, ScoreDetailBuilder.dfaAlpha1Adjustments shows the kind.

7-day ln(RMSSD) CV adjustment as (kind, points): (.variabilityFlat, cvFlatPenalty -5) when cv<2.0, (.variabilityErratic, cvErraticPenalty -3) when cv>12.0; nil for nil or in-range CV. The one copy: baselineNormalisedScore adds the points, ScoreDetailBuilder.cvAdjustments shows the kind.
ANS balance (PNS-SNS) adjustment: -6 if < -1.5, -3 if < -0.5, +2 if >= 1.5, else 0; 0 when nil.
